cues: A brilliant argument in the wrong layout loses the format marks and cannot get them back.
So decide which of four forms is asked for: a letter to the editor, an email, an application with a C V, or a letter of complaint or request.
The eight marks: two for format, three for content, one for organisation, two for language.
Write a hundred and fifty to two hundred words of body, in about eighteen minutes, two of them spent laying out the page.
